title: Grateful Dead Live at Cincinnati Music Hall on 1972-10-26
lineage: SBD -> Rm -> Cass -> Cass -> Dat -> Samplitude -> SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a little hiss captures an electrifying ‘Playing in the Band’ set highlighted by soaring Brokedown Palace and a monster Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The gd72‑10‑26.sbd.miller recording delivers solid soundboard quality – clear overall with only minor hiss and a brief cut‑off on the end of Brokedown Palace. Musically it’s a classic ’72 show, repeatedly praised for an epic Playing in the Band, powerful Dark Star, soulful Brokedown Palace and even a standout Casey Jones, showcasing Jerry’s wailing guitar and Phil’s booming bass.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.3/5; the majority of comments are enthusiastic about performance with only minor technical quirks, indicating a strong show and good soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced; listeners note a little hiss and a brief cutoff on the end of Brokedown Palace, but overall the mix is listenable and captures the band’s dynamics.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows naturally with a high‑impact Playing in the Band and Dark Star appearing together, creating an intense, cohesive second half that many fans call a classic ’72 performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his wailing ‘wawa’ guitar tone and soulful, emotionally charged playing throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass lines described as powerful and “bombing,” contributing to a tight, driving groove.
